maintenance_led.reason: Mostly sells engineered components such as brake pads, Goulds pumps, valves and connectors to OEMs and industrial customers, mainly new equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mainly private automotive, industrial, chemical and energy companies; aerospace and defense is a smaller part.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own engineered product lines in pumps, motion and connectors, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Components are qualified into customers' products and processes, such as auto brakes, pumps and aerospace connectors, so switching needs re-qualification.
